key_insight: M³-Gen predicts biologically plausible gene expression profiles from histopathology images plus clinical metadata, while also highlighting which image regions influenced the output.
clinical_relevance: This could help researchers estimate molecular profiles when gene expression testing is costly, unavailable, or privacy-sensitive, supporting multimodal cancer research and model development.
method: Uses a GAN to generate gene expression profiles conditioned on image and clinical inputs.
Learns a shared latent space with contrastive learning to align modalities.
Adds attention-based fusion for intrinsic interpretability of image regions and generated genes.
evidence_signal: On the TCGA dataset, the model produced realistic and functionally meaningful gene expression profiles according to the abstract.
watch_item: Generative results should be validated carefully across external cohorts and settings before any downstream research use, since performance may depend on dataset quality and modality alignment.
paper_title: M$^3$-Gen: Interpretable Multimodal Generation of Gene Expression Profiles Using Clinical and Imaging Data
